classification.difficultyReason: Reading exact intersection x-values from two graph pairs. The sin/tan part involves asymptotes and endpoint intersections at 0°, 180° and 360°; the sin/cos part needs a negative-domain intersection at -135°.

content.prompt: Use the graphs to find the $x$-coordinates of the points where they intersect.

answer.worked:
The curves meet only where both are zero, on the $x$-axis.
$$x=0^{\circ},\ 180^{\circ},\ 360^{\circ}$$

Reading the graph, the curves cross at
$$x=-135^{\circ}\ \text{and}\ x=45^{\circ}$$
